prerequisites: methodologies learned in Logic Design T

learning_outcomes.text: Provide basic computer architecture principles focusing on RISC (Reduced Instruction Set Computer) processors with a focus on the DLX CPU.
Design systems based on modern microprocessors focusing on interfacing techniques for memory and input/output devices.

syllabus_topics: RISC architectures and comparison to CISC architectures

assessment_methods.method: Written exam (questions regarding course topics and design of a CPU-based system)

assessment_rules: A satisfactory answer to the questions and the design of a CPU-based system is crucial for a positive evaluation.
bibliography: Hennessy Patterson -Computer architecture: a quantitative approach - Caps. 1..5 - Morgan Kaufmann pub. Inc.
David A Patterson, John L Hennessy, COMPUTER ORGANIZATION AND DESIGN, Morgan Kaufmann
